files.adaptation: Reuse FileTargetChip code-role-button markup, file type icon, inline typography, persistent underline, keyboard/modifier/context-menu activation and rich clipboard semantics. Existing WinOne ChatFileNavigation supplies scoped stat, viewer/media and shared useFileChipContextMenu. Markdown bare paths, explicit local links and inline paths share the existing Cindy parsing chain; missing/denied paths stay plain text. No remote file origin or new dependency.

Reuse handlePaste/onDrop file-before-text classification, native files/directories versus memory-only images, mutation locking and existing attachment actions. Replace Electron paths with WinOne CF_HDROP/OLE and scoped one-shot HTTP uploads; new-chat browser files remain in the protected in-memory draft and are imported before sending. No dependency added.
Unchanged keyboard, modifier/middle-click activation and keyboard context-menu positioning helpers.

Retain the shared flat local file/directory and HTML page/source menu, lazy path resolution, all local open/reveal/file-copy/path-copy/location-copy actions, modifiers, fixed pointer anchor and no-scroll focus restoration. Replace Electron/toast/context wiring with scoped WinOne Host, native file clipboard, existing sidebar/browser callbacks and local error feedback. WinOne has no remote session origins; no remote features are advertised. No dependency added.
Unchanged network detection and bounded reconnect-attempt parser. WinOne adds Bun socket diagnostics only in its presentation adapter.

Adapt the specialized authentication/rate-limit/network precedence and friendly-summary/original-detail separation to existing ChatFeedback. Keep WinOne actions and durable receipts unchanged, never claim a retry is in progress without runtime evidence. Remote Codex/account recovery is not introduced into the local Pi host.
